P. C. :
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.

2 By this petition, the petitioner seeks a direction to transfer the investigation of C. R. No. 331 of 2023, registered with the Kasarwadavli Police Station, District Thane, to the Crime Investigation Department or any other agency; direction is also sought to apply provisions of Sections 420, 395 of the Indian Penal Code as against the accused; direction is also sought to monitor the investigation and to take disciplinary action as against the Digitally signed by REKHA PRAKASH PRAKASH PATIL PATIL

Date:
2024.08.20 11:23:45 +0530 22-WP-3829-2023.odt respondent No.3 i.e. Mr. Manish Pote, attached to Kasarwadavli Police Station.

3 Mr. Saste, learned Additional P. P., on instructions, states that investigation in the said C.R. No.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submitted that two accused in the said case have been arrested and police will take steps as far as absconding accused.
He further states that the police during its investigation have till date not found any material to add sections 420 and 395 of the IPC to the C.R. in question.
He submits that the investigation will be taken to its logical end and the police will take the appropriate steps to arrest the accused.
4 In view of the aforesaid, it is not necessary to transfer the investigation to any other police station.

As far as the petitioner's prayer seeking disciplinary action against the respondent No.3 is concerned, it is open for the petitioner to take appropriate steps vis-a-vis the said respondent before the appropriate authority and as 22-WP-3829-2023.odt such, we do not wish to go into the allegations made against the said respondent.
5
In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, nothing survives for further consideration in the aforesaid petition.

PRITHVIRAJ K. CHAVAN, J. REVATI MOHITE DERE, J.
